{{Top|leg}}
The '''Fedalleans''' were the natives of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fedalle/Legends|Fedalle]]. Fedalleans were typically self-centered and did not care who ran the galactic government as long as they were taken care of. The Fedalleans were represented by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Hrekin Thorm]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="The Jedi Academy Sourcebook">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
